# RDS Package

**Package**: `@rapid7/rds`

Our Rapid7 Design System powered by MUI.

## Getting started

**Installation:**
Each package needs to be installed separately, for example:

```
npm i @rapid7/rds -S
```

or

```
yarn add @rapid7/rds
```

**Setup:**

```jsx
// Import the theme provider, theme brand and mode. note there are two brands and two modes available
import { BRAND_NAMES, THEME_MODES, RDSThemeProvider } from "@rapid7/rds";
// Import the global font styles
import "@fontsource/inter/300.css";
import "@fontsource/inter/400.css";
import "@fontsource/inter/500.css";
import "@fontsource/inter/700.css";
import "@fontsource/rubik/500.css";
import "@fontsource/rubik/700.css";
import "source-code-pro/source-code-pro.css";

const App = () => {
  return (
    <RDSThemeProvider
      brandName={BRAND_NAMES.CALLISTO}
      themeMode={THEME_MODES.DARK}
    >
      <div>
        <h1>My App</h1>
      </div>
    </RDSThemeProvider>
  );
};
```

**Import an Render a component:**

```jsx
import { Button } from "@rapid7/rds";

const MyComponent = () => {
  return <Button variant="contained">Click Me</Button>;
};
```

## Guiding Principles

Let these principles help shape what and how one contributes to this package.

### 1. MUI Native Feel

Custom component props and styling should "feel" like an MUI Native Component

- Custom Component Props: [Component API design](https://mui.com/material-ui/guides/api/)
- Themable Styling: [Creating themed components](https://mui.com/material-ui/customization/creating-themed-components/)

### 2. Follow the Open-Close Principle

Components (from MUI and custom-built) are Open for extension and closed to modification.

For example, we should not overwrite or replace the core MUI components and subsequently re-export them under identical
names (which is akin to modifying the original source code). Instead, we can extend them by leveraging the theme object or
create custom components that can provide the base functionality necessary and allow that to be extended.

### 3. Line in the Sand

This package should be a line in the sand. It should _not_ contain r7-ui remnants, including styled components.
Any bridges between the old world and the new should be made elsewhere.

## Package Structure

Under the `src` directory we have:

- **callistoTheme:** Customization of the MUI theme

  - **components:** Styling or default prop changes to the Core MUI components.

  - **palette:** Color tokens with our dark/light themes

  - **typography:** Customizations for text stuff

- **components:** Custom components built and supported by us all

- **originalTheme:** Customization of the MUI theme

  - **components:** Styling or default prop changes to the Core MUI components.

  - **palette:** Color tokens with our dark/light themes

  - **typography:** Customizations for text stuff

## Core tech

1. MUI Core/MUI-X Pro
2. Emotion
3. NextJS compatibility (coming soon)
